name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's journey in motorsport began unexpectedly, volunteering at local rally events in Quebec as a teenager. He quickly developed a fascination for the technical aspects of racing, leading him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering. After graduating, he worked his way up through various engineering roles in smaller racing teams, gaining invaluable hands-on experience with car setup, data analysis, and team management.

Jean-Pierre joined Akkodis ASP Team five years ago, initially as a senior engineer. His keen eye for detail, combined with his collaborative leadership style, saw him rapidly promoted to Head of Operations. He believes in fostering a culture of open communication and continuous improvement, always encouraging his team to push the boundaries of innovation. His ability to blend technical expertise with strategic thinking is what sets him apart, allowing him to optimize performance across all areas of the team's operations.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Jean-Pierre is of medium build, with a focused expression and a perpetually thoughtful gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against the table when deep in thought.
Insists on starting every team meeting with a brief, positive anecdote.
